description:
BinaryBchDecoder corrects words in internal (cyclic) coordinates only. A caller holding a word in a declared SystematicLayout (the default [message | parity] user layout or DVB_T2_LAYOUT) must apply the layout plan's coordinate map itself; 227ac5c8 needed a test-local helper in crates/gf2-coding/tests/bch_tests.rs for this.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The canonical binary BCH decoder (or LayoutView) decodes and corrects a received word given in a declared SystematicLayout without caller-side coordinate mapping, with an allocation-free path, and the bch_tests.rs helper is removed in favour of it.
title: Decode user-layout words with the canonical binary BCH decoder
